decision_authority: A human reviewer must choose exactly one allowed acquisition decision and name the approved scope. R6 records no approval.

recommendation_for_review.scope: Begin with Stage B controlled benign generation and, only after written safety authorization, Option A non-FA1B2de emulation. Use Option B/C/D only if a later scope explicitly names the bounded manifest schema and caps.
recommendation_for_review.reason: Local collector/encoder compatibility and bounded group identities are strongest for Stage B/A; official sources remain high-burden fallbacks with unknown provider objects/checksums.

review_checklist: Confirm Stage A remains WAIT_MININET_E1C and smoke-only.
Confirm Stage B has written local authorization, 24 whole groups, fixed seeds/durations, coverage, loss threshold, and reproducible hash chain.
Select at most one Stage-C option or a fixed-cap combination and record exact scope; do not use formal outcomes to choose.
For OpTC/TC E3, require provider object IDs, exact paths, byte lengths, and SHA-256 values before transfer; null identity/checksum blocks acquisition.
Confirm FA1B2de 53 playbooks/1796 actions remain excluded from training, tuning, calibration, fixtures, and seed decisions.
Confirm acquisition approval is separate from any detector training authorization.

approve: Materialize the named pre-acquisition manifest with all provider identities/checksums no longer null.
Verify source terms/authorization and transfer/storage caps.
Acquire only the approved bounded scope; verify raw and extracted hashes.
Run split, leakage/contamination, class-count, and 32D encoder compatibility gates.
Request a separate training release decision; do not train automatically.
reject: Acquire nothing; keep Track O reproduction and R6 design only; mark Track-L acquisition blocked.
request_smaller_or_different_subset: Create a new versioned scope and manifest schema decision; current null decision remains unchanged and no transfer occurs.
